infoBody: This is a short guide to Patternly's legal routes. Read the local Privacy Policy and Terms for the full rules; Support opens only the configured external destination.
publicLinksUnconfiguredDescription: This local build has no validated public environment, so the support link is disabled.
publicLinksInvalidDescription: The public environment configuration is invalid, so the support link is disabled.
publicLinkOpenFailedDescription: The configured public link could not be opened on this device.
privacyLinkDetail: Read the Privacy Policy in Patternly.
termsLinkDetail: Read the Terms of Service in Patternly.
supportLinkDetail: Open the configured public support destination.
complaintDetail: Report a service problem. We answer within 14 days of receipt; this is not a filing deadline.
withdrawalDetail: Eligible consumers generally have 14 days to withdraw without giving a reason. Read the Terms for the full rules.
privacyRequestsDetail: Exercise or check a privacy right. We normally respond within one month; a legal extension may add up to two months.
dataRecoveryDetail: Request recovery of eligible non-personal data. Deleted progress is not retained or restored.
suspensionAppealDetail: Ask for a manual review of a suspension decision. No fixed response time is promised.

legalRequests.emptyDetail: A request will appear here after it is sent.
legalRequests.accountRequired: This request channel is available only in a secure signed-in session. Guest intake is not available in the app.
legalRequests.guestIntro: Send this request using your email address. We will acknowledge receipt there.
legalRequests.emailRequired: Enter a valid email address before sending the request.
legalRequests.narrativePlaceholder: Add details if they help us handle the request. Do not provide passwords or codes.
legalRequests.transactionIdPlaceholder: Add the App Store transaction ID if available.
legalRequests.narrativeRequired: Add a short description before sending this request.
legalRequests.noResponseDue: The response timeframe is not available yet.
legalRequests.noResponse: A response is not available yet. Return after the status changes.

complaint.title: Service complaint
complaint.intro: Describe the service problem. We will acknowledge receipt and answer within 14 days. That response period is not a deadline for submitting a complaint.
complaint.formIntro: A short description helps us investigate the complaint.

withdrawal.title: Withdraw from the agreement
withdrawal.intro: Eligible consumers generally have 14 days to withdraw without giving a reason. Read the local Terms for eligibility, timing, and service-start rules.
withdrawal.formIntro: A reason is not required. Add a transaction ID only if you have one.

data_recovery.title: Recover non-personal data
data_recovery.intro: We assess eligible non-personal data manually and provide it within a reasonable time where applicable law requires. No fixed response time is promised. Deleted progress is not retained or restored.
data_recovery.formIntro: Describe the non-personal data you want us to assess for recovery.

suspension_appeal.title: Appeal a suspension
suspension_appeal.intro: This appeal is reviewed manually and separately from a complaint. No fixed response time is promised.
suspension_appeal.formIntro: Explain why the suspension should be reviewed.

topics.summary: Learning data is stored on this device; supported account records can also sync to the account cloud.
topics.title: Local storage
paragraphs: Patternly uses one canonical local storage boundary. Guest learning stays on this device unless you choose a network feature. For a signed-in account, supported records such as the active track, goals and plans, completed sessions, attempts, and review items can also synchronize with the account cloud.
Local storage does not by itself guarantee encryption, protection on a compromised device, or irrecoverable deletion. Patternly does not describe the current local data as encrypted.

topics.summary: Learning records are not tamper-proof credentials or official examination records.
topics.title: What this does not protect against
paragraphs: Patternly does not claim to protect data from an unlocked or compromised device, operating-system-level access, root or jailbreak access, backups, debug tooling, or forensic storage access.
Consistency checks protect the app's own learning records from duplicated or partial outcomes. They do not provide anti-cheat protection or independent proof of competence.

topics.summary: Results are personal practice evidence, not official certification or exam results.
topics.title: Independent study use
paragraphs: Patternly content is for independent study. Learning results are personal practice evidence and are not tamper-proof credentials, official examination records, or independently verifiable proof of competence.
Content review and validation support educational quality and lawful provenance. They do not make Patternly an official certification source or an endorsed training provider.

topics.summary: Local reset, account deletion, and limited deletion evidence have different scopes.
topics.title: Reset limits
paragraphs: Reset local learning history removes supported learning records from this device. It does not delete an account or its cloud copy; for a signed-in account, normal synchronization restores supported history after the reset.
Delete account is a separate in-app action that removes the account and synchronized learning data. It does not by itself cancel an App Store subscription.

Limited pseudonymized deletion safeguards and minimal proof that deletion completed can remain for their defined retention periods. The local Privacy Policy gives the exact scope, periods, legal bases, backup limits, and rights. Neither action is forensic secure erasure of operating-system copies or flash-memory remnants.
